correctness.summary: Independent induced-C4 check proves a nonzero Tor product for G9, and an independent 3-orbit × 6-bijection enumeration verifies all 18 gluings.

limitations: The archived enumeration script itself has a documented loop-indentation bug; the all-18 assertion was independently rechecked.
No claim is made for larger stacked blocks.

originality.summary: The non-Golod mechanism is standard; specificity of the named 18-gluing family is the main finite contribution.

scientific_value.summary: Provides a compact exact countercertificate to the proposed universal vanishing/Golod claim.
